conventions.coords: rect = [x, y, w, h] px in the source image; cells = [col, row] on the source grid; cells_index = linear index row-major
conventions.lut_order: luts apply left-to-right on SOURCE colours; L_SFX_BASE is always implied for simplefx unless a more specific LUT already mapped the colour
conventions.tint_tokens: see style-guide.md §2.4 — dev maps token names, never hexes
conventions.projectile_scale: visual scale = 1 if radius multiplier < 1.5, 2 if 1.5-2.49, 3 if >= 2.5 (size_up x1.6 -> x2). Hitbox follows data exactly; player visuals may exceed hitboxes, enemy bullets never do.
conventions.ebullet_rule: enemy projectile radius r -> ebullet.<element>.<2r+1> (frost 9/13 px have a rim broken at the 4 diagonals = segmented crystal ring, the grayscale cue for the slowing shot); radius 3/4/6 map exactly; any other radius -> nearest size DOWN (hitbox never smaller than the dark core). Death on wall/expiry: fx.ebullet_pop.

boss_telegraph.principle: Bosses have idle/run only. Every attack is told by FOUR stacked channels, none of them new body frames: (1) body tint ADD token telegraph-hot ramping to peak in the last 150 ms (Animator R5 priority 4); (2) a 1/8-step scale pulse (Animator R4) ; (3) a ground decal in the hostile telegraph colours showing WHERE; (4) a type glyph FX at the boss core showing WHAT.

per_attack_type.melee_swipe: decal: filled arc (arcDeg, range) telegraph-fill + 1px telegraph-rim; act: fx.enemy_slash scaled to range with integer steps (x1 <= 32 px range, x2 above); knight also raises boss_knight_blade overlay
per_attack_type.ring: decal: 1px telegraph-rim circle at 24 px pulsing; core glyph: fx.cast_glyph (hostile) ; bullets appear on the ring
per_attack_type.shoot: decal: 1 px telegraph-rim line per aimed bullet, 48 px long, locking 150 ms before release; core glyph: fx.cast_glyph (hostile)
per_attack_type.spiral: core glyph: fx.cast_glyph rotating + 1/8-step scale pulse 1.0/1.125 at 4 Hz
per_attack_type.charge: decal: lane rect (body width x charge length) telegraph-fill + rim, locked at windup start
per_attack_type.slam: decal: filled circle (radius) telegraph-fill + rim for windup+travel; landing = fx.explosion hostile variant
per_attack_type.summon: decal per spawn point: fx.summon_sigil (hostile protection circle) then fx.spawn_portal
per_attack_type.hazard: decal: circle (radius) telegraph-rim only during windup; active = hazard.<element>
per_attack_type.blink: fx.blink_puff at origin and destination; body alpha steps 1 -> 0.5 -> 0
per_attack_type.sequence: each step uses its own type
per_attack_type.self_destruct: (fire_imp) decal: filled circle at blast radius 36 telegraph-fill + rim from windup start; body: telegraph-hot + 1/8-step swell 1.0 -> 1.25 over the windup (Animator R4 transient) + FILL flash every 100 ms in the last 300 ms; act: fx.explosion hostile variant
per_attack_type.phase_change: invuln tint (R5 p5) + fx.phase_burst from core + camera flash owned by Animator/UX (reduced-motion safe)

floor.rule: seeded by fx rng per room; never two cracked (non floor_1) tiles orthogonally adjacent; floor under a wall row uses 0x72_floor idx 10-13 (top shadow fringe) at random

art.cells: cols 0-11 x rows 0-3 = the 3x3-minimal 47-tile blob template (godot-docs#3316)
art.draw: each 16x32 tile anchored so its bottom 16 px cover the grid cell; the top 16 px overhang the cell above (README y-offset); depth band wall-tops 80 for the overhang half

tiles.wall_edge_fix: use tile_list rects with TA fix wall_edge_top_left x=32 wherever tile_list edge pieces are used (door frames, decor)
